scripts.network: hc sandbox clean && npm run build:happ && concurrently -k -n bootstrap,conductors "npm run local-services" "sleep 1 && npm run launch:happ"
scripts.launch:happ: echo pass | hc sandbox --piped generate workdir/soushi-cloud.happ --in-process-lair --num-sandboxes $AGENTS --run=$(yes 0 | head -n $AGENTS | paste -sd, -) network --bootstrap http://127.0.0.1:${BOOTSTRAP_PORT:-4433} quic http://127.0.0.1:${BOOTSTRAP_PORT:-4433}
scripts.doc: RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --no-deps -p file_system -p file_system_integrity
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
